chars.DAUGHTER: a Moroccan young woman of about 23 with long loose dark wavy hair, wearing an oversized mustard-yellow hoodie and light blue jeans
chars.MOM: a Moroccan mother of about 50, round friendly face, wearing an emerald-green house djellaba and a loosely tied white headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Cozy Moroccan salon in a Kenitra apartment with low sedari couches and a brass tea tray. Seen from the doorway, head-to-waist: MOM is caught mid-act pouring mint tea from a high teapot, turning her head with raised eyebrows toward DAUGHTER, who stands nervously at the edge of frame clutching her phone. Light comic mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon. DAUGHTER sits close beside MOM on the sedari couch, fidgeting with her phone, biting her lip shyly, about to confess something. MOM looks at her curiously, holding a tea glass.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon. MOM beams with joy, both hands raised in happy surprise, eyes shining, while DAUGHTER smiles shyly and looks down. Warm light, comic happy mood.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon, over-the-shoulder view. DAUGHTER holds up her phone toward MOM; the phone screen shows a photo of a smiling young East Asian man (no text on screen). MOM leans in, squinting at the phone, her smile freezing.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon. MOM in exaggerated shock, one hand over her mouth, eyes wide, the tea glass tilting in her other hand. DAUGHTER shrinks into the couch with an awkward grin. Comic cartoon reaction.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon. MOM stands up shouting dramatically, waving both arms in the air, headscarf slipping. DAUGHTER covers her ears with both hands, wincing. Funny over-the-top family argument.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon. DAUGHTER laughs uncontrollably holding her belly on the couch, while MOM stands with arms crossed, lips pressed, totally unconvinced and annoyed.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon. MOM points a finger firmly at DAUGHTER with a stern, shocked face, as if she has just understood something serious. DAUGHTER raises her palms, pleading. Tense but cartoonish.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment hallway. MOM and DAUGHTER stand side by side whispering, both looking worriedly toward a closed wooden door at the end of the hallway (the father's room). MOM bites her nail nervously, DAUGHTER clasps her hands.
